text:
The Meridian plan defines six modules: quota, profile, archive, indexer, catalog, and search. The indexer depends on quota and must not depend on archive, directly or indirectly. Search depends on profile, quota is assigned to delta, and profile rolls out before catalog, which runs on worker alpha. Profile and search run on different workers, while profile and archive share one. The events.py and paths.py files belong to profile.

Settings: catalog retry_limit is 9, requiring quota max_workers ≤ 4. Search queue_depth is 350. Archive queue_depth is 260, requiring indexer ttl_s ≤ 60. A correction sets search timeout_s to 50. The indexer may optionally run on delta, and archive timeout_s is around 90 at the team's discretion.

Action items: Ravi checks whether the legacy exporter can be retired, code review turnaround stays under one day, budget review moves to next Thursday, the indexer runbook is rewritten, and an archive design review is scheduled after launch.
